items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: And Zito is the one that told me

ctx.x: As I understand, he dated one of the Boswell sisters. He dated her? He dated, I think Martha.

I mean, it could have been, but then Zito knows him better than I do. And Zito is the one that told me, he says, man, he says, Emmet, it's a little dark, you know. Yeah, well, what the hell, he might love being a little dark. He said, he ain't got, now Zito, he's like, that might have come out of the sky, you know. But Emmet was from across the road, in that section over there where they had those little coffee and a cake, coffee and a milk, you know. In Algiers? Yeah, yeah. Can you remember hearing him play?…
Would it be possible to ask, some have said that Emmet Hardy had a great deal of influence on Bix Beiderbecke? Do you remember Beiderbecke's playing in the game?
